name: integer-modulo
source:
Print 17 Mod 5
Print 17 Mod (-5)
Print (-7) Mod 4
Print (-1) Mod 10
Print (-2147483648) Mod 3
Print 7 Mod 0
Print (-7) Mod 0

encoding.notes: Hand-specified instruction bytes, independent of TokenTable and test/helpers/tokens.js. Print=0x0476, integer=0x003e, /=0xffec, Mod=0xffd4. Negative constants are signed raw words. Source is a readable semantic equivalent, not an exported ASCII/binary pair.

evidence.notes: Op_Modulo normalizes the divisor sign only and performs unsigned restoring division on all 32 bits of the dividend. It has no zero-divisor branch; subtraction of zero leaves the dividend bits as the remainder. This records interpreter source behavior, including unusual negative/zero cases; it is not an emulator capture.
